recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-43380 unless a future OO decision changes the product-category hierarchy or MPHO scope.
issue_request: FHIR-43380 was an Applied/Persuasive OO request for R6 to update the BiologicallyDerivedProduct productCategory terminology by changing biologicalAgent to biological-agent and adding mpho to the product-category code system and value set.
initial_application: Historical commit ad9eb1f5d24e964805d858972fdf16ca9679baf1 renamed biologicalAgent to biological-agent and added mpho to source/biologicallyderivedproduct/codesystem-product-category.xml. Follow-up commit 8ae2eac825e15852b66b6116127f0bb90e1df7fb corrected the display to Biological agent. The ValueSet composes the complete product-category code system, so mpho is included without an individual concept listing.
additional_context: OO HCP minutes for 2024-02-12 record the same motion and 9-0-1 vote. The Jira comment conditioned comfort on FHIR-43381 also being actioned; current source has BiologicallyDerivedProduct.productCategory as 0..* with the approved category-or-classification wording, and FHIR-43381 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 7c173cd8820ecd0a95ac996c77a040528421eedc.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because the combined branch already has biological-agent, the mpho concept, the whole-code-system ValueSet include, and the related multi-category productCategory element context.

related_jiras.note: Approved in the same OO HCP meeting and needed so MPHO can be one of multiple overlapping product categories; already represented on the combined branch by 7c173cd8820ecd0a95ac996c77a040528421eedc.
